title: Adopt fleet operating-block amendment: fast-forward promotion clarification + AskUserQuestion rule
description: opum-agent amended the canonical fleet operating block (digest f4f86992e7321116 -> 0ba99c441c7a13b6): resolves the self-contradiction where a fast-forward dev->main push was both 'ordinary delivery' and in the user-authority dangerous set, and adds a rule to use AskUserQuestion instead of prose for user-facing decisions. Also add a line naming the opum-sdlc skill in this repo's CLAUDE.md (currently only opum-agent's CLAUDE.md names it).

acceptanceCriteria.text: CLAUDE.md fleet-operating block matches opum-agent dev:scratchpad/fleet-operating-block.md byte-for-byte (v2, digest 0dc1d83ec87f26f8)

CLAUDE.md names the opum-sdlc skill as the fleet development-lifecycle skill
required-checks ruleset claim independently verified against actual GitHub config, not taken on anyones word

implementationNotes: Superseded mid-task: opag/user pushed a v2 of the operating block (digest 0ba99c441c7a13b6 -> 0dc1d83ec87f26f8) replacing an unverified anecdote ('opum-cli-e2e's first attempt was rejected...') with a verifiable claim about the required_status_checks rule being attached to the main ref with zero bypass actors. Diffed v1 vs v2 byte-for-byte before adopting: only that one paragraph changed. Independently verified via gh api repos/opum-ai/quest-cli/rules/branches/main and .../rulesets that the claim is true for this repo (rule present, bypass_actors: []). Adopting v2 instead of v1.

Superseded again: v2 was itself wrong (generalised every fleet repo gates main with zero bypass actors; false for lore-cli, which gates dev instead - independently confirmed via gh api repos/opum-ai/lore-cli/rules/branches/main returning []). v3 (digest 47c8d11f09e5bcce) drops the universal claim entirely, keeps only the safe invariant (main only ever receives a fast-forward of a gated dev), and pushes per-repo branch-protection facts into each repos own profile block. Added quest-clis measured facts (required_status_checks on main, bypass_actors: []) to the repo profile per v3s instruction. Adopting v3.
finalSummary: Adopted the fleet operating-block amendment on origin/dev (commit 8ab52ba, PR #251) after three revisions, each verified independently against live GitHub config rather than taken on any partys word. v1 fixed the blocks self-contradiction (fast-forward dev->main push was both ordinary and dangerous-set). v2s justification cited an unverified handover anecdote - replaced with a checkable claim, which I confirmed true for quest-cli via gh api. v3 caught v2s overgeneralization (false for lore-cli, which gates dev not main, confirmed via gh api) and moved per-repo facts into each repos own profile block. Final digest 47c8d11f09e5bcce, confirmed via CIs own awk+shasum extraction and the operating block digest CI job (green). Also recorded quest-clis own measured branch-protection shape in its profile, and named the opum-sdlc skill as this repos development-lifecycle skill. lore check exit 0 throughout.
